config.adapter_image: ran-rl-twin-adapter:latest, built on the host from twin-host-source.tar.gz
config.description: team-hosted Maveric twin (staging guide 1.2.9), http backend

evaluation.command: make evaluate, on the twin host, on the model fetched by make download
evaluation.episodes: 20 (nominal, congestion, interference, outage x 5 seeds), model and rule baseline
evaluation.gate_note: the five gates are reported as measured and are not part of the target; UPLIFT is expected to FAIL at 2,048 steps and is advisory
evaluation.twin: ran_rl LocalDigitalTwin, in-process (starter config/env.yaml twin.backend: local)

items.evaluation-report-written: passed when make evaluate on the downloaded SageMaker model writes reports/evaluation.json and reports/evaluation.md and evaluation.json holds all five gates
items.sagemaker-job-completed: passed when DescribeTrainingJob reports TrainingJobStatus Completed

training.command: make train-sagemaker TIMESTEPS=2048 (on the Mac; the job runs on SageMaker)

config.twin_host: team13 EC2 c5.4xlarge i-0acf4648786c5adf7 (us-east-2), adapter-team1 on port 8001 (TEAM_NO=1), bearer token; address and token are not recorded here
